# Wikipedia Article

Title: Attention Is All You Need
Canonical URL: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Attention_Is_All_You_Need

The Transformer is a deep learning architecture introduced in the paper Attention Is All You Need.
Authors of the work include researchers at Google Brain. Author: Ashish Vaswani and co-authors.
The model relies on self-attention instead of recurrence or convolution.
It became the foundation of large language models and many sequence tasks.
The original paper describes multi-head attention, positional encodings, and feed-forward layers.
Subsequent work scaled the architecture to billions of parameters.
The Wikipedia article summarizes the architecture, history, and influence of the Transformer.
Related topics include BERT, GPT, and encoder-decoder models used in machine translation.
The page also lists citations, further reading, and external links to the original PDF.
Researchers continue to study efficiency improvements such as sparse attention and linear attention.
